# Cncf Kusk Gateway Reviewer

Review Kusk Gateway using its official documentation and repository in the Orchestration &amp; Management / API Gateway category. Kusk Gateway is a self-service API gateway powered by OpenAPI and Envoy. Kusk Gateway is built and maintained by Kubeshop.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
